{{Quote|Hr=SS|For our base, we require the gelatinous Mossberry Stew. Its concoction is a druidic art, a jealously guarded secret of the moss-painted caverns deep below us.|[[Loyal Mergwin]]}}

<b>Mossberry Stew</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Mossberry Stew is one of the five ingredients required for the <i>[[Great Taste of Pharloom]]</i> wish. It is given to [[Loyal Mergwin]] in the [[Choral Chambers]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Loyal Mergwin 01.png!Location in the Choral Chambers
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Loyal Mergwin 02.png!Loyal Mergwin in the Choral Chambers
}}

== How to Acquire ==
During <i>Great Taste of Pharloom</i>, [[Moss Druid]] freely hands over Mossberry Stew to [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]].

}}
